<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #0d0f1a; }
  body { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; }
  canvas {
    background: #161a2e; border: 2px solid #3a4170; border-radius: 6px;
    max-width: 100vw; max-height: 100vh; cursor: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  const HUD_H = 40;

  // Level layouts: '1' = 1-hit brick, '2' = 2-hit brick, '.' = empty
  const LEVELS = [
    {
      speed: 5,
      rows: [
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
      ],
    },
    {
      speed: 6.5,
      rows: [
        '2.22222222.2'.slice(0, 10),
        '1211111121',
        '1.211112.1',
        '11.2112.11',
        '111.22.111',
        '2111..1112',
        '1221111221',
      ],
    },
  ];
  const COLORS = ['#ff5c7a', '#ff9f43', '#feca57', '#1dd1a1', '#54a0ff', '#a29bfe', '#ff6bcb'];

  const BRICK_COLS = 10, BRICK_GAP = 6, BRICK_H = 22, BRICK_TOP = HUD_H + 40, SIDE = 30;
  const BRICK_W = (W - SIDE * 2 - BRICK_GAP * (BRICK_COLS - 1)) / BRICK_COLS;

  const paddle = { w: 110, h: 14, x: W / 2 - 55, y: H - 40, speed: 9 };
  const ball = { x: 0, y: 0, r: 8, vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: 5 };

  let bricks = [];
  let score = 0, lives = 3, level = 0;
  let state = 'start'; // start | serve | play | paused | levelClear | gameOver | win
  let levelClearTimer = 0;
  const keys = {};

  function buildLevel(i) {
    bricks = [];
    LEVELS[i].rows.forEach((row, r) => {
      for (let c = 0; c < BRICK_COLS; c++) {
        const ch = row[c];
        if (ch === '1' || ch === '2') {
          const hp = Number(ch);
          bricks.push({
            x: SIDE + c * (BRICK_W + BRICK_GAP),
            y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_GAP),
            w: BRICK_W, h: BRICK_H, hp, maxHp: hp,
            color: COLORS[r % COLORS.length],
          });
        }
      }
    });
    ball.speed = LEVELS[i].speed;
  }

  function resetBall() {
    ball.vx = 0; ball.vy = 0;
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
  }

  function newGame() {
    score = 0; lives = 3; level = 0;
    buildLevel(level);
    paddle.x = W / 2 - paddle.w / 2;
    resetBall();
    state = 'serve';
  }

  function launch() {
    const angle = (Math.random() * 40 - 20) * Math.PI / 180;
    ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
    state = 'play';
  }

  // Primary action: Space / Enter / click
  function action() {
    if (state === 'start' || state === 'gameOver' || state === 'win') newGame();
    else if (state === 'serve') launch();
    else if (state === 'paused') state = 'play';
  }

  function togglePause() {
    if (state === 'play') state = 'paused';
    else if (state === 'paused') state = 'play';
  }

  // ---- Input ----
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    keys[e.key] = true;
    if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') { action(); e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (e.key === 'p' || e.key === 'P' || e.key === 'Escape') togglePause();
    if (e.key.startsWith('Arrow')) e.preventDefault();
  });
  document.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });

  function canvasX(clientX) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return (clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  }
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    if (state === 'paused') return;
    paddle.x = canvasX(e.clientX) - paddle.w / 2;
    clampPaddle();
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { e.preventDefault(); action(); });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
    paddle.x = canvasX(e.touches[0].clientX) - paddle.w / 2;
    clampPaddle();
    e.preventDefault();
  }, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); action(); }, { passive: false });

  function clampPaddle() {
    paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));
  }

  // ---- Update ----
  function update(dt) {
    if (state === 'levelClear') {
      levelClearTimer -= dt;
      if (levelClearTimer <= 0) {
        level++;
        buildLevel(level);
        resetBall();
        state = 'serve';
      }
      return;
    }
    if (state !== 'play' && state !== 'serve') return;

    const left = keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a'] || keys['A'];
    const right = keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d'] || keys['D'];
    if (left) paddle.x -= paddle.speed * dt;
    if (right) paddle.x += paddle.speed * dt;
    clampPaddle();

    if (state === 'serve') { resetBall(); return; }

    // Sub-step to avoid tunnelling at higher speeds
    const steps = Math.ceil(ball.speed * dt / 4);
    for (let s = 0; s < steps && state === 'play'; s++) stepBall(dt / steps);
  }

  function stepBall(dt) {
    ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
    ball.y += ball.vy * dt;

    // Walls
    if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if (ball.y - ball.r < HUD_H) { ball.y = HUD_H + ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

    // Paddle
    if (ball.vy > 0 &&
        ball.y + ball.r >= paddle.y && ball.y - ball.r <= paddle.y + paddle.h &&
        ball.x + ball.r >= paddle.x && ball.x - ball.r <= paddle.x + paddle.w) {
      const hit = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2); // -1..1
      const angle = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, hit)) * 60 * Math.PI / 180;
      ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
      ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
      ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
    }

    // Fell off bottom
    if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
      lives--;
      if (lives <= 0) { lives = 0; state = 'gameOver'; }
      else { resetBall(); state = 'serve'; }
      return;
    }

    // Bricks (one per step)
    for (let i = 0; i < bricks.length; i++) {
      const b = bricks[i];
      const cx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(ball.x, b.x + b.w));
      const cy = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(ball.y, b.y + b.h));
      const dx = ball.x - cx, dy = ball.y - cy;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy > ball.r * ball.r) continue;

      const overlapX = Math.min(ball.x + ball.r - b.x, b.x + b.w - (ball.x - ball.r));
      const overlapY = Math.min(ball.y + ball.r - b.y, b.y + b.h - (ball.y - ball.r));
      if (overlapX < overlapY) {
        ball.vx = ball.x < b.x + b.w / 2 ? -Math.abs(ball.vx) : Math.abs(ball.vx);
      } else {
        ball.vy = ball.y < b.y + b.h / 2 ? -Math.abs(ball.vy) : Math.abs(ball.vy);
      }

      b.hp--;
      if (b.hp <= 0) {
        score += b.maxHp > 1 ? 20 : 10;
        bricks.splice(i, 1);
      } else {
        score += 10;
      }

      if (bricks.length === 0) {
        if (level + 1 < LEVELS.length) { state = 'levelClear'; levelClearTimer = 120; }
        else state = 'win';
      }
      break;
    }
  }

  // ---- Draw ----
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // HUD
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f1224';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a4170';
    ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H - 2, W, 2);
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 16, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Level ' + (level + 1) + ' / ' + LEVELS.length, W / 2, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5c7a';
    ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + '♥'.repeat(lives) + '♡'.repeat(3 - lives), W - 16, HUD_H / 2);

    // Bricks
    for (const b of bricks) {
      roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = b.hp < b.maxHp ? 0.55 : 1;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      if (b.maxHp > 1) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
        if (b.hp < b.maxHp) { // crack
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(b.x + b.w * 0.3, b.y);
          ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.5, b.y + b.h * 0.5);
          ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.4, b.y + b.h);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
    }

    // Paddle
    roundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 7);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#54a0ff';
    ctx.fill();

    // Ball
    if (state !== 'gameOver' && state !== 'start') {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Overlays
    switch (state) {
      case 'start':
        overlay('BRICK BREAKER',
          'Move: Mouse or ← → / A D    Launch: Click / Space    Pause: P / Esc',
          'Click or press Space to start');
        break;
      case 'serve':
        hint('Click or press Space to launch');
        break;
      case 'paused':
        overlay('PAUSED', '', 'Press P / Esc / Space or click to resume');
        break;
      case 'levelClear':
        overlay('LEVEL ' + (level + 1) + ' CLEAR!', 'Score: ' + score, 'Get ready for level ' + (level + 2) + '...');
        break;
      case 'gameOver':
        overlay('GAME OVER', 'Final score: ' + score, 'Click or press Space to play again');
        break;
      case 'win':
        overlay('YOU WIN!', 'Final score: ' + score, 'Click or press Space to play again');
        break;
    }
  }

  function overlay(title, sub, prompt) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 12, 25, 0.75)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#feca57';
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 50);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '18px system-ui, sans-serif';
    if (sub) ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H / 2 + 5);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a5b1d8';
    ctx.font = '20px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(prompt, W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
  }

  function hint(text) {
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a5b1d8';
    ctx.font = '18px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, H - 90);
  }

  // ---- Loop ----
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(3, (now - last) / (1000 / 60)); // normalized to 60fps frames
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  buildLevel(0);
  resetBall();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

      if (b.hp <= 0) {
        score += b.maxHp > 1 ? 20 : 10;
        bricks.splice(i, 1);
      } else {
        score += 10;
      }

      if (bricks.length === 0) {
        if (level + 1 < LEVELS.length) { state = 'levelClear'; levelClearTimer = 120; }
        else state = 'win';
      }
      break;
    }
  }

  // ---- Draw ----
  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // HUD
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f1224';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3a4170';
    ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H - 2, W, 2);
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 16, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Level ' + (level + 1) + ' / ' + LEVELS.length, W / 2, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5c7a';
    ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + '♥'.repeat(lives) + '♡'.repeat(3 - lives), W - 16, HUD_H / 2);

    // Bricks
    for (const b of bricks) {
      roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = b.hp < b.maxHp ? 0.55 : 1;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      if (b.maxHp > 1) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
        if (b.hp < b.maxHp) { // crack
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(b.x + b.w * 0.3, b.y);
          ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.5, b.y + b.h * 0.5);
          ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.4, b.y + b.h);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
    }

    // Paddle
    roundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 7);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#54a0ff';
    ctx.fill();

    // Ball
    if (state !== 'gameOver' && state !== 'start') {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Overlays
    switch (state) {
      case 'start':
        overlay('BRICK BREAKER',
          'Move: Mouse or ← → / A D    Launch: Click / Space    Pause: P / Esc',
          'Click or press Space to start');
        break;
      case 'serve':
        hint('Click or press Space to launch');
        break;
      case 'paused':
        overlay('PAUSED', '', 'Press P / Esc / Space or click to resume');
        break;
      case 'levelClear':
        overlay('LEVEL ' + (level + 1) + ' CLEAR!', 'Score: ' + score, 'Get ready for level ' + (level + 2) + '...');
        break;
      case 'gameOver':
        overlay('GAME OVER', 'Final score: ' + score, 'Click or press Space to play again');
        break;
      case 'win':
        overlay('YOU WIN!', 'Final score: ' + score, 'Click or press Space to play again');
        break;
    }
  }

  function overlay(title, sub, prompt) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 12, 25, 0.75)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#feca57';
    ctx.font = 'bold 52px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 50);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '18px system-ui, sans-serif';
    if (sub) ctx.fillText(sub, W / 2, H / 2 + 5);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a5b1d8';
    ctx.font = '20px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(prompt, W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
  }

  function hint(text) {
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a5b1d8';
    ctx.font = '18px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, H - 90);
  }

  // ---- Loop ----
  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(3, (now - last) / (1000 / 60)); // normalized to 60fps frames
    last = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  buildLevel(0);
  resetBall();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

I've written the brick-breaker game to `index.html` in the current folder, but I haven't run it. I tried a quick syntax check of the game code and it needed your approval, so it didn't run. I also haven't opened it in a browser, so it's untested.

What's in it, all in that one file:
- **Score display:** the top bar shows Score, Level (1/2) and Lives as hearts.
- **3 lives:** missing the ball costs a life, and losing all 3 shows Game Over.
- **Mouse:** moving the mouse moves the paddle, and a click starts the game or launches the ball. It also works by touch.
- **Keyboard:** ←/→ or A/D move the paddle, Space or Enter launches, and P or Esc pauses.
- **2 levels:**
  - Level 1 is a full 5×10 grid of bricks that break in one hit.
  - Level 2 has a patterned layout with outlined bricks that take two hits and crack after the first. The ball is also faster.
- **Gameplay:**
  - Where the ball hits the paddle sets its bounce angle, so you can aim.
  - Each brick hit scores 10 points, and breaking a two-hit brick scores 20.
  - Clearing level 1 shows a short "Level clear" screen before level 2, and clearing level 2 shows "You Win".
  - After the game ends, a click or Space starts a new game.

To try it, double-click `index.html` or run `start index.html` in the folder.
